//: The root tsconfig.json is the Vite client config: noEmit, moduleResolution bundler, DOM libs, JSX. Vercel's Node builder reads the nearest tsconfig when it compiles api/*.ts, so with only the root config every function compiled to nothing and every /api/* route returned FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED — including a handler that imports nothing. tsx never noticed, because tsx ignores noEmit. This config is the server half: emit real CommonJS for Node, resolve imports the way CommonJS does, and keep DOM and JSX out. src/server is bundled by esbuild instead, so it is deliberately not compiled here.
